scripts.db:name: echo p$(pwd -P | shasum -a 256 | cut -c1-15)
scripts.db:fresh: sh -c 'set -e; name=$(bun run --silent db:name); pgx run >/dev/null; force=0; for arg; do case "$arg" in --force) force=1;; *) echo "usage: bun run db:fresh [--force]" >&2; exit 2;; esac; done; if [ "$force" -eq 1 ]; then pgx drop "$name" --force; fi; pgx create "$name"' --
scripts.dev: APP_ENV=dev DATABASE_URL="$(pgx url "$(bun run --silent db:name)")?sslmode=disable" go run ./cmd serve
scripts.dev:http: APP_ENV=dev DATABASE_URL="$(pgx url "$(bun run --silent db:name)")?sslmode=disable" go run ./cmd http
scripts.dev:worker: APP_ENV=dev DATABASE_URL="$(pgx url "$(bun run --silent db:name)")?sslmode=disable" go run ./cmd worker
